# laravelcloud_environment (Data Source)

Reads an existing Laravel Cloud environment by ID. Useful when a Terraform module needs to reference an env created in a separate state OR via the Cloud dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reads an existing Laravel Cloud environment by ID.
#
# The `variables` attribute is Sensitive — expose only via a `sensitive`
# output when a consumer downstream truly needs to read them.

data "laravelcloud_environment" "production" {
  id = "env_01HAM..."
}

output "production_branch" {
  value = data.laravelcloud_environment.production.branch
}

# Uncomment when you actually need to fan-out env vars to downstream state.
# output "production_variables" {
#   value     = data.laravelcloud_environment.production.variables
#   sensitive = true
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Cloud-assigned environment ID (ULID).

### Read-Only

- `application_id` (String) ID of the owning application.
- `branch` (String) Source-control branch this environment auto-deploys from. Null for non-source-controlled envs.
- `cache_id` (String) ID of the cache bound to this env.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of environment creation.
- `database_schema_id` (String) ID of the database schema bound to this env.
- `inherits_id` (String) ID of a parent env this env inherits variables from. Common patterns: staging inherits from development, preview envs inherit from development.
- `name` (String) Environment slug — one of `development`, `staging`, `production`, or a `preview-pr-<n>` per-PR env.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of last mutation.
- `variables` (Map of String, Sensitive) Per-environment env-var map. Values are encrypted at rest on the Cloud side. Sensitive values should live in Doppler + be referenced via env-var substitution rather than stored here in cleartext.
